claims.text: At all tested moduli2..18, exact cyclotomic arithmetic verifies the fourth-moment/collision identity and all2,108 unit-scaling orbit sizes; collision elimination, the size-at-most-two map and the stated tau3 counting bound pass exactly.

All1,960 tested incomplete inverse sums agree with their exact v-coprimality Mobius expansion; coefficient gcds equal gcd(k,u). All132 finite Fourier-completion identities pass, with empty divisor intervals retained.
The unit-H hypothesis cannot be dropped from the claimed complete-frequency simplification: u2,H2,k1 gives actual complete sum+1, whereas the unit-based Ramanujan center is-1.

Equal coefficient gcd does not make incomplete sums equal: u3,H2 andH4,k1 on the stated short interval give distinct zeta3 and zeta3^2 sums. Omitting v-coprimality at u3,H2,V2 changes the exact sum from0 to-1.

All300 bounded-frequency complement phase multisets agree exactly with fixed-u inverse grouping. Finite Mobius mass expansions and normalized circular discrepancies are exact on the60 tested domains; empty populations are not divided by zero.
The finite stage does not establish the analytic cancellation exponent, discrepancy asymptotics, prime-list applicability or Goldbach.
